prompt:
Redesign the attached Kvarta mobile landing-page mockup to feel noticeably cozier and more visually welcoming. Image 1 is the previous concept to revise; image 2 is typography inspiration only. Preserve the fictional Minsk roastery's business facts and readable Cyrillic, not the previous rigid composition. Render a 390×844 mobile viewport at 2×, edge to edge, no device frame.

Use peach #FCEDE3 as the main canvas, warm cream surfaces, cocoa-brown text and soft warm-orange actions. Keep the broad geometric wordmark character from the typography reference, but soften the headline hierarchy with sentence case and breathing room. Never copy RANAK's name, trademark or food offerings.

Composition: a morning-table ritual rather than a clinical isolated product. One Kvarta coffee bag and a handmade ceramic cup sit together on a broad soft cream oval against peach. Show gentle daylight and a little linen within the still life. The bag's warm orange label reads «КВАРТА / БРАЗИЛИЯ СЕРРАДО / 250 г». Keep one dominant organic shape and calm supporting regions; avoid copy beside product in separate hero columns. Use the welcoming headline «Ваше утро начинается с кофе». Include «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим» and «Партиями по 5 кг».

Keep a real compact callback panel with labelled «Имя» and «Телефон» (mask «+375 (__) ___-__-__»), one interest group «Разовый заказ / Подписка / Вопрос», an expandable «Комментарий (необязательно)» row, and clearly clickable «Оставить заявку». Use «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором». Show «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка — 54 BYN / месяц», «2 пачки по 250 г, доставка включена». The wordmark and menu frame the top; the next section begins «Кофе на выбор» and «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN». No invented reviews, discounts or contacts.
